title: Customer-fidelity capture profiles & stability harness for Private/VPC workloads
creator: Marcus Lin
description: Build a reproducible harness that captures lightweight customer workload profiles inside Private / VPC environments and uses them to run stability and regression benchmarks on on-prem and VPC deployments. The harness should produce token/sec and p95 latency time series, support controlled noise injection (network, CPU jitter), and run nightly diff jobs that surface regressions with automated triage hints.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Able to capture and export a compact profile (<=10MB) representing request size distribution, sequence prefixes, routing mix, and KV-cache hit patterns from a VPC deployment.
2) Replayer can run the profile against an on-prem image and a hosted replica with parameterized noise knobs, producing per-endpoint tokens/sec and p95 latency histograms.
3) Nightly regression job computes unit-normalized delta vs baseline; creates a ticket when tokens/sec drops >5% or p95 increases >10% with p<0.05 (stat test).
4) Outputs include time-series CSV, heatmap of kernel hotspots, and a linkable dashboard that shows failing traces and sample requests.
5) Feature has end-to-end test and a dry-run mode that runs without touching production configs.
design_notes: Capture format: newline-delimited JSON with anonymized prompt fingerprints, sequence length, model variant, routing bucket, and KV cache keys hashed. Keep profile <10MB by sampling and sketching long-tail tokens.

Replay engine will be a lightweight harness that can run inside customer's VPC container or on an isolated on-prem node. It will support rate-scaling to match 95th percentile arrival patterns and a 'bursty' mode for stress runs.
Regression detection: use bootstrap confidence intervals on median tokens/sec and p95; flag if delta exceeds thresholds AND CI does not cross zero. Store raw samples for postmortem.
Instrumentation: emit Prometheus-style metrics (tokens_total, tokens/sec gauge, latency_bucket for p50/p95/p99), plus an artifact bundle containing kernel counters and GPU utilization samples.
test_plan: Unit tests for capture serialization and anonymization logic.
Integration test that runs a small profile against a local runtime container and validates emitted metrics match expected distributions.
E2E night-run in staging that compares current runtime to baseline image; verify ticket creation and dashboard links.
Chaos scenarios: CPU stealing and 10-50ms network tail added to verify detection and result stability.
comments: 2026-02-26 Marcus Lin: Kickoff — captured initial design goals and core acceptance criteria. Decided on compact capture artifact to simplify exfil inside customer VPCs.
2026-03-02 Priya Nair: Prototype replay harness working locally. Early runs show tokens/sec variance of ~3% on repeat runs; need to widen bootstrap samples to stabilize p-values.
2026-03-05 Infra ops: Blocker — requires IAM permission to deploy ephemeral capture container into a customer's VPC; coordinating with solutions engineering for an onboarding checklist.
2026-03-09 Data team: Added suggestion to include a small sketch of KV access patterns to help emulate cache hit distributions without leaking keys.
2026-03-12 Priya Nair: Implemented automated ticket creation hook to our internal tracking when regression sentinel fires; adding sample diffs and top-3 suspect kernel counters to ticket body.
rollout: Phase 1: internal staging only; Phase 2: opt-in partner runs for two pilot customers; Phase 3: nightly platform job for all private clusters (opt-out).
